value.question: What is a crossover trial design?
plan: A crossover trial design involves participants switching treatments during the study.
Each participant receives all interventions in a sequence.
Outcomes are compared within the same individual across treatment periods.

value.draft: A crossover trial design is a type of study where participants switch between different treatments during the study. Each participant receives all interventions in a specific sequence. This allows researchers to compare the effects of each treatment within the same individual across different treatment periods. By analyzing outcomes within the same person, the design can reduce variability and increase the precision of the results. This approach is commonly used in clinical research to evaluate the effectiveness of various treatments.
